what: attempt 1 of the fullcontext system stalled and the VM was stopped by Claude at about 20:55 UTC
evidence: Cloud Monitoring model_invocation_count for gemini-3-flash-preview, 18:50-20:10 UTC: about 9,900 responses with code 429, 9 with 504, about 700 with 200; no log line from the run after 18:50; no answers_fullcontext.json was written, so no phase D answer or verdict exists from attempt 1
cause: 64 concurrent ~20k-token phase D calls on the Flex tier were mostly refused with 429; the runner's model calls had no timeout, so the run waited without end on calls that never returned

changes: 15-minute timeout on every model call, retried
20 attempts with jittered backoff up to 180 s instead of 10 up to 90 s
phase D calls limited to 12 in flight (FULLCONTEXT_CONCURRENCY)
a progress log line every 100 finished calls
a resumed run skips systems already finished (the baseline)
code_change.effect_on_measurement: none: prompts, models, settings, judge and statistics are unchanged; the baseline answers and verdicts from attempt 1 stand

spend: about 700 successful phase D calls in attempt 1 were not metered; 25 SEK (an upper estimate) is added to meter_extra as fullcontext:lost_attempt_1 so the cost guard counts it; billing gives the real figure
smoke: a new smoke run with the changed code must pass before this run resumes
